estate-spend.title: Total spend vs previous period
estate-spend.subtitle: Every account with usage in this window. The dashed line is the previous period, laid under this one.

spend-by-account.title: Spend by account
spend-by-account.subtitle: The twelve highest-spending accounts. Values on hover.

spend-by-model.title: Spend by model over time
spend-by-model.subtitle: Daily spend, split by model. Bar height is the day's total; the tail past the top five is one summed Other segment, never dropped.

top-spender-projects.title: Top spenders — projects
top-spender-projects.subtitle: Spend the backend attributed to no project is folded into a labelled Unassigned row, never dropped.

request-volume.title: Request volume
request-volume.subtitle: Error rate is not shown — usage events carry no error/status signal today (lightbridge-authz#597).

latency-by-model.title: Latency by model
latency-by-model.subtitle: Percentiles are computed per bucket by the usage backend; each card states the WORST bucket in this window, never an average of percentiles. p99 is hidden below 100 samples.

active-accounts.title: Active accounts
active-accounts.subtitle: Only counts accounts with usage in this window — an account with zero usage never appears in an estate-wide usage query at all.

active-projects.title: Active projects
active-projects.subtitle: Same window and the same limit; spend attributed to no project is not counted as one.

adoption-over-time.title: Active accounts & projects per day
adoption-over-time.subtitle: Distinct accounts and projects with at least one request in each bucket.

total-cost.title: Total cost
total-cost.subtitle: Every account with usage in this window

total-requests.title: Total requests
total-requests.subtitle: Error rate is not shown — usage events carry no error/status signal (lightbridge-authz#597).

accounts-by-plan.title: Accounts with usage, by plan
accounts-by-plan.subtitle: Distinct accounts that drew something in this window. An account with no usage never appears in a usage query at all, so this is not a census of the estate.

avg-cost-per-million-tokens.title: Average cost per million tokens
avg-cost-per-million-tokens.subtitle: A dash, not $0.00, when the window carries no token counts — an embeddings or image call has none, and "free" would be a fabricated reading.

active-actors.title: Active actors
active-actors.subtitle: Only counts actors with usage in this window. Follows the lens.

cost-by-model.title: Cost per period by model
cost-by-model.subtitle: Bar height is the period's total spend; segments are the top five models plus one summed Other.

cost-by-actor.title: Cost per period by actor
cost-by-actor.subtitle: Follows the lens above — users, accounts or projects.

cost-by-channel.title: Cost by channel
cost-by-channel.subtitle: Which OAuth client the spend arrived on. Rows open the channel.

top-actor-cost.title: Top actors by cost
top-actor-cost.subtitle: Rows open that actor's own usage. Follows the lens.

chat-completions-count.title: Chat completions
chat-completions-count.subtitle: Requests on the chat-shaped surfaces — /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages.

actors-table.title: Actors
actors-table.subtitle: Cost, requests, tokens and last activity per actor. Rows open that actor. Last activity is the start of the most recent bucket with usage, not an event timestamp.

channels-table.title: Channels
channels-table.subtitle: Cost and requests per OAuth client. Rows open the channel.

actor-total-cost.title: Total cost
actor-total-cost.subtitle: This actor's own spend in the window picked above, not in the budget period.

actor-total-requests.title: Total requests
actor-total-requests.subtitle: Error rate is not shown — usage events carry no error/status signal (lightbridge-authz#597).

actor-cost-by-model.title: Cost per period by model
actor-cost-by-model.subtitle: Log axis by default — one dominant model flattens every other line on a linear one.

actor-cost-by-channel.title: Cost by channel
actor-cost-by-channel.subtitle: Which OAuth client this actor's spend arrived on. Rows open the channel.

actor-chat-completions-count.title: Chat completions
actor-chat-completions-count.subtitle: Requests on the chat-shaped surfaces — /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages.

channel-total-cost.title: Total cost
channel-total-cost.subtitle: Spend that arrived on this OAuth client, across every account.

channel-total-requests.title: Total requests
channel-total-requests.subtitle: Error rate is not shown — usage events carry no error/status signal (lightbridge-authz#597).

channel-cost-by-model.title: Cost per period by model
channel-cost-by-model.subtitle: Log axis by default — one dominant model flattens every other line on a linear one.

channel-chat-completions-count.title: Chat completions
channel-chat-completions-count.subtitle: Requests on the chat-shaped surfaces — /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages.

channel-actors.title: Actors on this channel
channel-actors.subtitle: Cost per user on this client. Rows open that actor.

channel-requests-by-operation.title: Requests by operation
channel-requests-by-operation.subtitle: Which API surface this client calls.

chat-latency-series.title: Chat latency over time
chat-latency-series.subtitle: p50 and p95 per bucket, computed by the usage backend at query time — never an average of percentiles. No TTFT is emitted by the gateway, so first-token latency is absent rather than estimated.

chat-latency-cards.title: Latency by model
chat-latency-cards.subtitle: Each card states the WORST bucket in this window, never an average of percentiles. p99 is hidden below 100 samples.

chat-requests-by-operation.title: Requests per period by operation
chat-requests-by-operation.subtitle: The three chat surfaces plotted apart — a migration from one to another is visible here and nowhere else.

chat-cost-by-model.title: Chat cost per period by model
chat-cost-by-model.subtitle: Log axis by default — one dominant model flattens every other line on a linear one.

spend-total.title: Spend in this range
spend-total.subtitle: The range picked above, not the budget period the BUDGET card states.

spend-over-time.title: Spend over time
spend-over-time.subtitle: The account total, with the previous period dashed underneath it.

spend-by-project.title: Spend by project
spend-by-project.subtitle: Spend the backend attributed to no project is a labelled Unassigned row, never dropped.

spend-by-model.title: Spend by model over time
spend-by-model.subtitle: Bar height is the day's total for this account; segments are the top five models plus one summed Other.

latency-by-model.title: Latency by model
latency-by-model.subtitle: Percentiles are computed per bucket by the usage backend; each card states the WORST bucket in this window, never an average of percentiles. p99 is hidden below 100 samples.

spend-by-api-key.title: Spend by API key
spend-by-api-key.subtitle: Spend the backend attributed to no key is a labelled Unassigned row.

account-cost-by-channel.title: Cost by channel
account-cost-by-channel.subtitle: Which OAuth client (azp) the spend arrived on. Values are in the tooltip on screen, and in the panel's own table in an exported report.

account-tokens-by-channel.title: Tokens by channel
account-tokens-by-channel.subtitle: Tokens by OAuth client (azp) — the same window and the same request as the cost ring.

account-requests-by-channel.title: Requests by channel
account-requests-by-channel.subtitle: Requests by OAuth client (azp) — a channel can be a large share of the calls and a small share of the cost.

account-cost-by-project.title: Cost by project
account-cost-by-project.subtitle: The project split of the same spend the ranked list above orders, off the same request. Values are in the tooltip on screen, and in the panel's own table in an exported report.

family-cost.title: Cost
family-cost.subtitle: Every account in your family, summed over the range picked above. There is no family BUDGET figure to put beside it — a ceiling is per-account.

family-cost-per-request.title: Cost / request
family-cost-per-request.subtitle: Blank when the window carries no requests at all — a mean over nothing is not a number.

family-accounts.title: Accounts
family-accounts.subtitle: Only accounts with usage in this window — an account that drew nothing never appears in a usage query at all.

family-spend.title: Spend over time
family-spend.subtitle: Every account in your family, summed. The dashed line is the previous period.

spend-by-account.title: Spend by account
spend-by-account.subtitle: One line per account, values on hover.

family-spend-by-project.title: Spend by project
family-spend-by-project.subtitle: Across every account in your family. Two accounts' projects are different projects, even when they share a name. Spend attributed to no project is a labelled Unassigned row, never dropped.

family-model-share.title: Spend by model — share
family-model-share.subtitle: The share across every account in your family. Spend the backend attributed to no model is a labelled Unassigned segment, never dropped.

family-spend-by-model.title: Spend by model over time
family-spend-by-model.subtitle: Log axis by default — one model at ~100% share flattens every other line on a linear one.

family-latency-by-model.title: Latency by model
family-latency-by-model.subtitle: Percentiles are computed per bucket by the usage backend; each card states the WORST bucket in this window across your whole family, never an average of percentiles. p99 is hidden below 100 samples.

family-spend-by-api-key.title: Spend by API key
family-spend-by-api-key.subtitle: Across every account in your family. Spend the backend attributed to no key is a labelled Unassigned row.

family-cost-by-channel.title: Cost by channel
family-cost-by-channel.subtitle: Which OAuth client (azp) the spend arrived on, across your whole family. Values are in the tooltip on screen, and in the panel's own table in an exported report.

family-tokens-by-channel.title: Tokens by channel
family-tokens-by-channel.subtitle: Tokens by OAuth client (azp) — the same window and the same fan-out as the cost ring.

family-requests-by-channel.title: Requests by channel
family-requests-by-channel.subtitle: Requests by OAuth client (azp) — a channel can be a large share of the calls and a small share of the cost.

family-cost-by-project.title: Cost by project
family-cost-by-project.subtitle: The project split of the same spend the ranked list above orders, off the same fan-out. Projects are not shared between accounts, so a family with 25 accounts has 25 disjoint sets of them here.

family-cost-by-account.title: Cost by account
family-cost-by-account.subtitle: The account split of the family total above — the reading this page exists for, and the one a single account's overview has no rows to draw.

cost-per-request.title: Cost / request
cost-per-request.subtitle: Blank when the window carries no requests at all — a mean over nothing is not a number.

spend-over-time.subtitle: The account total across every project and model.

spend-over-time.subtitle: This project's total across every key and model.

spend-by-api-key.title: Spend by API key
spend-by-api-key.subtitle: Spend the backend attributed to no key is a labelled Unassigned row, never dropped.

latency-by-model.subtitle: Percentiles are computed per bucket by the usage backend; each card states the WORST bucket in this window, never an average of percentiles. p99 is hidden below 100 samples.

spend-over-time.subtitle: Your own usage, across every account and project you drew from.
